findings.title: Required fields per stage
findings.evidence: 1 pipeline(s) have a stage that does not require the configured fields: amount.
findings.recommendedFix: Mark those properties required before a record can enter the stage.
findings.retest: Move a test deal into the stage with the field blank and confirm HubSpot blocks the move.

findings.title: Required properties filled
findings.evidence: 1 required property name(s) are below the fill ratio: email.
findings.recommendedFix: Make the thin properties required on the create forms and backfill the blanks.
findings.retest: Agree which fields are required, backfill any field still under the ratio, and rerun the audit.

findings.title: Workflow health
findings.evidence: 1 workflow(s) are in error. 1 active workflow(s) have no enrolment.
findings.recommendedFix: Open the errored workflows and fix the failing action.
findings.retest: Open each errored workflow, fix the failing action, and confirm a new test contact enrols.

findings.title: Form field mapping
findings.evidence: 1 form field(s) have no property mapping.
findings.recommendedFix: Map each field to a contact or company property.
findings.retest: Submit the form once and confirm each answer lands on the intended contact property.

findings.title: Sync errors
findings.evidence: 1 app(s) and 1 webhook(s) report sync errors.
findings.recommendedFix: Open the failing sync and replay or pause it.
findings.retest: Find the integration that created the bad row, correct that route, and rerun a ten-row import.

findings.title: Email hooks by buyer stage
findings.evidence: 6 journey stage(s) have no matching published email: lead, marketingqualifiedlead, salesqualifiedlead, opportunity, customer and 1 more.
findings.recommendedFix: Add one email or workflow for each uncovered stage.
findings.retest: Move one test contact into each uncovered stage and confirm the matching email or workflow exists.

findings.title: Stale deals
findings.evidence: 1 sampled deal(s) have not been updated for 30 days or more.
findings.recommendedFix: Create a workflow that tasks the owner when a deal goes stale.
findings.retest: Agree the stale-day threshold, let the task workflow fire on one quiet deal, and rerun the audit.

findings.title: Lifecycle and lead status
findings.evidence: 1 contact(s) use a conflicting lifecycle stage and lead status.
findings.recommendedFix: Clear the conflicting lead status when lifecycle stage changes.
findings.retest: Agree the allowed lifecycle and lead-status pairs, clear any conflicting row, and rerun the audit.

findings.title: Nurture sequence
findings.evidence: No active nurture sequence was found.
findings.recommendedFix: Add one short nurture for new leads.
findings.retest: Enrol one new lead and confirm the nurture sends, then stops when the contact becomes a customer.

findings.title: Webhook subscriptions
findings.evidence: 1 webhook subscription(s) are inactive.
findings.recommendedFix: Repair or remove the inactive subscription.
findings.retest: Send one test event and confirm the subscription receives it.

findings.title: Automation on stage change
findings.evidence: 1 pipeline(s) have no stage-change automation.
findings.recommendedFix: Add a workflow or stage action for the first handoff stage.
findings.retest: Move one test deal into the handoff stage and confirm the workflow enrols that deal.

findings.title: Dynamic lists
findings.evidence: No dynamic list was returned.
findings.recommendedFix: Build dynamic lists for the stages you email.
findings.retest: Change one contact's lifecycle stage and confirm the dynamic list gains or loses that contact.

findings.title: Lead score
findings.evidence: No lead-score property was returned.
findings.recommendedFix: Turn on predictive lead scoring or name your score property in the YAML.
findings.retest: Open a scored contact and confirm the score property has a current value.

findings.title: Record owners
findings.evidence: 1 owner record(s) are present.
findings.recommendedFix: Give every new contact and deal an owner.
findings.retest: Create one test contact and confirm an owner is set before it is routed.

findings.title: GDPR consent on forms
findings.evidence: 1 live form(s) have no GDPR consent field.
findings.recommendedFix: Add a consent checkbox and store the lawful basis.
findings.retest: Submit the form and confirm the contact stores the consent checkbox and the lawful basis.

findings.title: Cookie banner
findings.evidence: The public page does not show a known cookie-banner marker.
findings.recommendedFix: Add a consent banner before non-essential HubSpot cookies load.
findings.retest: Load the page in a fresh browser and confirm non-essential cookies wait for the banner.

findings.title: Sender domain authentication
findings.evidence: 1 sender domain(s) are missing a pass on SPF, DKIM, or DMARC.
findings.recommendedFix: Publish the missing DNS records before the next campaign.
findings.retest: Query the sender domain and confirm SPF, DKIM, and DMARC each return a pass.

findings.title: Subscription type on published emails
findings.evidence: Published emails are tied to a subscription type.
findings.recommendedFix: Keep one subscription type per email.
findings.retest: Open each published email and confirm it is tied to one subscription type before the next send.

findings.title: Email subscription types
findings.evidence: 1 subscription type(s) are defined.
findings.recommendedFix: Map each marketing email to one subscription type.
findings.retest: Open the subscription settings and confirm each marketing email maps to one type.

findings.title: Unengaged contacts
findings.evidence: No workflow handles unengaged contacts.
findings.recommendedFix: Add a sunset workflow after a set number of unopened emails.
findings.retest: Mark one test contact unengaged and confirm the sunset workflow suppresses further sends.

findings.title: Spam protection
findings.evidence: 1 live form(s) have no captcha and no honeypot field: Demo request (on a public page, 12 submissions in 30 days). The forms API does not return HubSpot's honeypot toggle, so confirm that setting in the form editor if you use it.
findings.recommendedFix: Turn on captcha or add a honeypot field.
findings.retest: Submit the form once as a person and confirm a bot-style submission is blocked or dropped.

findings.title: Logo on landing pages
findings.evidence: Published pages include a logo image or SVG.
findings.recommendedFix: Put the logo in the shared page header.
findings.retest: Open the landing page and confirm the shared logo is visible in the header.

findings.title: Landing page call to action
findings.evidence: Published landing pages include a call to action.
findings.recommendedFix: Point the action at one form or one meeting link.
findings.retest: Click the call to action and confirm it opens the intended form or meeting link.

findings.title: Published landing pages
findings.evidence: 1 landing page(s) are published.
findings.recommendedFix: Keep a draft only while it is still being edited.
findings.retest: Open the primary campaign URL and confirm the published page loads.

findings.title: Live forms
findings.evidence: 2 form(s) are not archived.
findings.recommendedFix: Archive forms that no page still embeds.
findings.retest: Load the primary page and confirm the live form is the one that should accept submissions.

findings.title: Landing page colour palette
findings.evidence: Published pages use a stylesheet or a small colour set.
findings.recommendedFix: Keep new pages on that palette.
findings.retest: Compare the page with the shared palette and confirm no extra colours were introduced.

findings.title: Favicon on landing pages
findings.evidence: 1 published page(s) have no favicon.
findings.recommendedFix: Add a rel=icon link in the page head.
findings.retest: Reload the page and confirm the browser tab shows the favicon.

findings.title: Page heading
findings.evidence: Published pages include a level-one heading.
findings.recommendedFix: Give each landing page one h1.
findings.retest: Open the page and confirm it has one level-one heading.

findings.title: Landing page titles and descriptions
findings.evidence: 1 published landing page(s) are missing a title or meta description.
findings.recommendedFix: Fill the HTML title and meta description before the next campaign.
findings.retest: View the page source and confirm the title and meta description match the offer.

findings.title: Follow-up email
findings.evidence: 1 embedded form(s) have no follow-up email.
findings.recommendedFix: Add a follow-up email or a workflow enrolment on submit.
findings.retest: Submit the embedded form from an inbox you control and confirm the follow-up arrives.

findings.title: Extra brand phrases
findings.evidence: No extra phrases are configured. Logo, favicon, heading, and colour checks still run.
findings.recommendedFix: Add params.markers only for words that must appear verbatim.
findings.retest: Search the published HTML for each configured phrase and confirm it is present.

findings.title: Unused forms
findings.evidence: 1 live form(s) are not embedded.
findings.recommendedFix: Embed the form or archive it.
findings.retest: Archive each unembedded form or place it on a page, then rerun the audit.

findings.title: Tracking code on the public site
findings.evidence: The public page HTML does not include the HubSpot tracking script.
findings.recommendedFix: Add the portal tracking code to the site layout.
findings.retest: Load the public page and confirm the HubSpot tracking script request returns.

findings.title: Tracking on landing pages
findings.evidence: 1 published landing page(s) have no tracking script.
findings.recommendedFix: Add the portal tracking code to the landing page template.
findings.retest: Load the landing page and confirm the tracking script request returns.

findings.title: Lifecycle funnel
findings.evidence: The contact sample spans 4 lifecycle stages.
findings.recommendedFix: Use the same stage names on the funnel report.
findings.retest: Compare the funnel stage names with the lifecycle property and confirm they match.

findings.title: Original source attribution
findings.evidence: Original source is missing on too many sampled contacts.
findings.recommendedFix: Stop blank imports from clearing original source.
findings.retest: Import one new contact and confirm the import does not clear original source.

findings.title: Deal stage probabilities
findings.evidence: 1 later deal stage(s) are below 40% probability.
findings.recommendedFix: Set a realistic probability on each open stage.
findings.retest: Agree the probability floor, set it on each open stage, and rerun the audit.

findings.title: Campaign links on live assets
findings.evidence: 2 published page or email asset(s) have no campaign.
findings.recommendedFix: Attach each live asset to a campaign.
findings.retest: Open each live asset and confirm it is attached to the campaign for that offer.

findings.title: Attribution reports
findings.evidence: No attribution report was returned.
findings.recommendedFix: Add an attribution report for paid and organic channels.
findings.retest: Open the attribution report and confirm paid and organic channels both appear.

findings.title: Dashboards
findings.evidence: 1 dashboard(s) are present.
findings.recommendedFix: Keep one operating dashboard for the revenue team.
findings.retest: Open the operating dashboard and confirm pipeline and lifecycle both render.

findings.title: UTM capture
findings.evidence: UTM properties exist but most sampled values are empty.
findings.recommendedFix: Pass UTM parameters into hidden form fields.
findings.retest: Open the form with utm_source set and confirm the hidden field stores that value.

findings.title: Ticket pipeline
findings.evidence: 1 ticket pipeline(s) are defined.
findings.recommendedFix: Keep a closed stage and a required resolution field.
findings.retest: Open a test ticket, move it to closed, and confirm the pipeline still has a resolution field.

findings.title: Duplicate companies
findings.evidence: 1 domain(s) are shared by more than one company.
findings.recommendedFix: Merge companies that share a domain.
findings.retest: Import two companies that share a domain and confirm they are blocked or merged.

findings.title: Duplicate contacts
findings.evidence: 1 email address(es) are shared by more than one contact.
findings.recommendedFix: Merge the duplicate contacts and turn on a create-time duplicate rule.
findings.retest: Import ten rows that repeat one email and confirm HubSpot does not create a second contact.

findings.title: Unused custom properties
findings.evidence: 1 custom property name(s) have no values: favourite_glass.
findings.recommendedFix: Archive unused properties or start collecting them on a form.
findings.retest: Archive each named property or place it on a form, then rerun and confirm the fill count is no longer zero.

findings.title: Connected apps
findings.evidence: 1 app(s) are connected.
findings.recommendedFix: Remove apps you no longer use.
findings.retest: Disconnect any app you no longer use and confirm the remaining apps still sync.
